15/S0.subgoal: Introduce and identify the main categories of AR hardware systems.

15/S1.subgoal: Describe the application areas for the various AR device categories.

15/S2.subgoal: Compare AR headsets to VR headsets and describe their internal components and functionality.

15/S3.subgoal: Describe the features and functionality of smart glasses and lightweight wearable AR devices.

15/S4.subgoal: Differentiate between marker-based and markerless AR used in handheld devices.

15/S5.subgoal: Define spatial AR and explain its fundamental features and requirements.

15/S6.subgoal: Provide examples of spatial AR implementation technologies, such as interactive projectors and projection mapping.

15/S7.subgoal: Compare Head-up Displays (HUDs) with emerging technologies like AR contact lenses.

15/S8.subgoal: Summarize the different categories and concepts of AR hardware systems discussed in the lecture.
